description: Simplified color recommendation rules. Maps skin undertone + contrast level to recommended and avoid color palettes per garment zone (near face vs lower body).

warm.description: Yellow/golden/peachy undertones. Gold jewelry flatters. Veins appear green.
warm.near_face_priority: Warm tones near face bring out healthy glow. Earthy and golden hues.

cool.description: Blue/pink/red undertones. Silver jewelry flatters. Veins appear blue/purple.
cool.near_face_priority: Cool tones near face create even, healthy complexion. Blue and grey bases.

neutral.description: Mix of warm and cool. Both gold and silver work. Most flexible palette.
neutral.near_face_priority: Widest flexibility. Focus on contrast level rather than temperature.

high_contrast.description: Light skin + dark hair (or dark skin + grey/white hair). Features in powerful counterpoint.
high_contrast.outfit_approach: CAN wear bold color contrasts. Dark jacket + white shirt works. Black and white combinations enhance natural drama.
high_contrast.avoid: All-muted/tonal dressing dampens natural drama. Don't dress too safe.

medium_contrast.description: Moderate difference between skin and hair. Most common type.
medium_contrast.outfit_approach: Most flexibility. Can wear true hues with slight shading/tinting. Medium contrast in clothing matches well.
medium_contrast.avoid: Extremely high contrast outfits (stark black+white) may overpower.

low_contrast.description: Features similarly light (fair+blonde) or similarly dark (dark skin+dark hair). Features blend together.
low_contrast.outfit_approach: MUST keep clothing contrast low — tonal dressing. Monochrome or analogous color schemes. Bold contrasts draw attention away from face.
low_contrast.avoid: Stark black+white, bright contrasting colors. These bully the face into submission (Flusser).

indian_skin_specific.description: Most Indian men fall in the medium to dark skin depth range with warm to neutral-warm undertones. These are specific recommendations for common Indian coloring.

common_profiles.profile: Medium brown skin + dark hair (most common)
common_profiles.note: Rich, medium-depth colors work best. Avoid anything that washes out or makes skin look ashy.
Can wear bold, saturated colors confidently. White and jewel tones pop beautifully against dark skin.
High contrast coloring — can handle bold clothing contrast. Navy and white is a power combo.
The most versatile Indian coloring. Earthy tones and jewel tones both work. Lucky you.

near_face.rule: Colors from your recommended palette have MAXIMUM effect near the face. This is where undertone matching matters most. Wrong color here = washed out or sickly appearance.

lower_body.rule: Lower body can be more neutral. Navy, charcoal, and dark denim work for almost everyone. Color precision matters less below the waist.

footwear.rule: White, black, brown, and navy are universal. Match belt to shoes if wearing a belt.
